states.hidden: no measured gain or broken: greyed in the menu with the reason as its hint

categories.visual-taste: the user's choice; no benchmark decides it

flags.name: QUAD
flags.reason: Main screen as a compositor layer: sharper text. On by default because the user preferred it.

flags.name: MIPQ
flags.reason: Lanczos-2 mip chain instead of a 2x2 box: crisper text when a screen is shrunk, at some GPU cost. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: CURVE
flags.reason: User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: MARGIN
flags.reason: Off: the transparent margin shrank the panel and moved the edge line outward. User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: SUPER
flags.reason: Meta's quality super-sampling for the main screen layer: smoother edges for some GPU. User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: BEZEL
flags.reason: A frame over the panel edge; on by default because it removed the edge line completely. User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: FADE
flags.reason: User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: GLASS
flags.reason: User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: AMBI
flags.reason: The frame glows with the screen's colours: the user's pick.

flags.name: SPELL
flags.reason: Draw a circle in the air to summon a screen. User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: MACDISP
flags.reason: Extra screens are real Mac displays streamed back; off shows placeholders and removes them from the Mac.

flags.name: SAVESET
flags.reason: Remember the toggles across launches. User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: RESUME
flags.reason: Reopen the last source at start. User's choice: how it looks or feels; no benchmark decides it.

flags.name: HOSTRES
flags.reason: Find the laptop by mDNS name instead of a fixed address; on by default since v0.40.

flags.name: H264
flags.reason: Game stream in H.264 instead of HEVC (low-latency rate control). Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain. Equal latency keeps HEVC (better quality per bit).

flags.name: VT
flags.reason: Virtual texturing: full detail only where you look, tails for hidden screens. Paired with the sender vt flag. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: BUDGET
flags.reason: One arbiter shares Wi-Fi between atlas, game and assets. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: GPUTIME
flags.reason: GPU timer queries for diagnostics; feeds BUDGET. Measurement only.

flags.name: WIFILL
flags.reason: Android low-latency Wi-Fi lock. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: LODPOSE
flags.reason: Detail level from viewing distance and angle. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: HERO
flags.reason: A big, focused screen gets its own stream instead of the atlas. Paired with the sender hero flag. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: KEYREQ
flags.reason: Ask the sender for a keyframe after loss instead of waiting for a periodic one. Pairs with sender noperiodic. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: MODELS
flags.reason: Show a streamed 3D model. Feature in development.

flags.name: SHOULDER
flags.reason: Menu button by the shoulder (house onboarding). Feature in development.

flags.name: HOUSE
flags.reason: Keep the layout in house.json on the Mini (house/README.md). Feature in development.

flags.name: DEPTHGAP
flags.reason: Measure screens against the real walls from depth (wallfit.h). Diagnostic.

flags.name: WRIST
flags.reason: Tap the wrist for a ring menu. Feature in development.

flags.name: SCAN
flags.reason: Scan button in the menus: fit the walls in front of you into house.json. Feature in development.

flags.name: WALLTOOL
flags.reason: Draw lines and circles on the walls and extrude lines into surfaces from the WALLS menu; shapes saved in house.json. Feature in development.

flags.name: ASSIST
flags.reason: A Claude button on every screen: press, speak, and that screen's assistant answers in a chat panel beside it (docs/prd/assistant-protocol.md). Feature in development.

flags.name: SCROLL
flags.reason: Wave an open hand (palm away) up/down/left/right to scroll the screen you point at: Moonlight wheel for the main screen, 'w' on the Air mouse port for extra screens. Feature in development.

flags.name: vt
flags.reason: Sender half of virtual texturing (levels, tiles, mip tails). Single Wi-Fi pair: fresh 48 -> 56 fps but gap p99 32 -> 105 ms; synth localhost 62 fps. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: longgop
flags.reason: Periodic keyframes every 10 s instead of 2 s. Air A/B: keyframes 16 -> 4, fresh 40 -> 46 fps (one pair). Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: noperiodic
flags.reason: No periodic keyframes at all; keyframes only on connect, layout change or headset request (KEYREQ). Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: bpcut
flags.reason: Bitrate x0.7 under backpressure. Single A/B at 3 Mbit/s WAN: frames 148 -> 318, keyframes 23 -> 7, gap p99 583 -> 343 ms. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: damage
flags.reason: Skip copies of unchanged frames. encprobe showed no effect: ScreenCaptureKit marks every frame dirty. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: prifps
flags.reason: Background screens at 10-15 fps by priority. encprobe: atlas 40 -> 29 fps. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: gameyield
flags.reason: While a game plays, the atlas encodes 1 tick in 2-4 so the game gets the media engine. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: gamecap
flags.reason: While a game plays, the atlas is laid out within 1920x1200. With gameyield: game encode 40 fps / 277 ms -> 60 fps / 13 ms (encprobe). Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: capfast
flags.reason: Capture interval half a refresh (1/120 s at 60 fps) so frames landing a hair early are not skipped. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: nodelay
flags.reason: TCP_NODELAY on the headset connections (Nagle held each frame's last partial segment for an ACK). Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: pend1
flags.reason: Encode only when nothing is still in flight to any peer (default: up to 1 frame queued). Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: pace
flags.reason: Paced sends: 16 KB chunks at 1.5x the bitrate, so Wi-Fi sees no bursts. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: hero
flags.reason: Sender half of HERO: own HEVC stream for the hero screen, with a share of the BUDGET. Off until the benchmark campaign (stand-in + Air, 3x A/B vs v0.37 defaults) shows a measurable gain.

flags.name: nowake
flags.reason: Turns OFF the display wake while a headset is connected. The wake is a fix (virtual displays vanish when the Mac display sleeps), so this stays off; kept only for tests.
